Create only docs/implementation/live-recording-adapter-plan.md. Read the complete creative-input, live timeline, controlled-replay and live-input capture plans. Inspect the delivered transcript importer, mapping and timeline owners, and the actual runtime input and publication owners. LUX-82 integrated the importer from source 2bd21901a2cf258e373811a91f1514dfb8699ab3.

Define the I02c3b recording boundary against actual runtime calls. Preserve original receipts before coalescing, event order, source authority changes, clock epochs, complete base and host values, and explicit loss or incomplete endings. Identify the exact owner that can witness whether timeline, mapping and runtime publication committed together. A self-consistent supplied transcript is not proof of collection or publication. Do not invent a transaction or runtime identity that the current source does not provide.

Select a coherent first source leaf with exact files, APIs, types, limits, failures and reachable CPU fixtures. Record any required runtime owner prerequisite with source evidence. Separate pure adapter tests from actual live recording, storage, device, hardware and pixel validation. Keep hashing and truthful collection claims separate. Use read-only probes of actual owners and controlled seams.

Do not implement application source, add a device provider, file persistence, runtime execution, Studio, MCP, SDK capability or native process. Submit one document for fresh independent review and serial integration. All existing native and physical gates remain.
